description: Source code for a fuzzed datagram client socket implementation used for testing network socket behavior with fuzzing data.

classes.name: FuzzedDatagramClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket class for fuzz testing network datagram sockets, simulating connect, read, write, and other socket operations with fuzzed data.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a specified IP endpoint, succeeding or returning an error based on fuzzed data.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Stub method for connecting using a specific network handle; not implemented.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Stub method for connecting using the default network; not implemented.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to connect to an endpoint, invoking callback upon completion.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Stub for async connect using a network handle; not implemented.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Stub for async connect using default network; not implemented.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns an invalid network handle.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag; empty implementation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket, resetting internal state.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address if connected.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address if connected.

methods.name: UseNonBlockingIO
methods.description: Enables non-blocking IO; empty implementation.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets multicast interface; stub returning not implemented.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns network log object.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from socket, returning data or error based on fuzzed input.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to socket, simulating success or failure based on fuzzed input.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets receive buffer size; returns OK.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets send buffer size; returns OK.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets do-not-fragment flag; returns OK.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon read completion, runs the provided callback.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon write completion, runs the provided callback.
